name: NexusLink
install: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun" bash -s bun-v1.3.14 && (sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun && sudo ln -sf "$HOME/.bun/bin/bunx" /usr/local/bin/bunx || true) && export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && bun install

terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: All NexusLink apps via turbo: desktop RPC host (ws/http :45678) + Next.js UI (:3000), mobile PWA (:3001), signaling relay (ws :3033). Run `bun run lan` instead for the single-port QR-pairing host.
